title: #14255: Add metrics to track chunk allocations and deallocations

timeline.message: #14255: Add metrics to track chunk allocations and deallocations
timeline.author: raipc

timeline.body:
Motivation:

Added metrics to track chunk allocations and deallocations so allocation rate by the arena can be tracked.

Modification:

Added `numChunkAllocations`, `numChunkDeallocations`, `numActiveChunks` to `PoolArenaMetric`

Result:

Fixes #14255.
Maybe we should return -1 by default and add to the javadocs that -1 is returned when "unknown" ? Same for all the other methods.
We could add a comment that all other `destroyChunk` calls comes from the arena itself being finalized, and so don't need to be counted.
Looks good once the comments are resolved.

timeline.message: Added a comment why pooledChunkDeallocations not increased in other places
timeline.author: raipc

timeline.message: New metrics return -1 if not defined
timeline.author: raipc
